notes.title: Patch Notes: Banishing the Dark Bugs ✨
notes.notes:
Wizards and witches, seduction flows freely again! 💋
The cursed glitches that dared to chain your desires and freeze your pleasure have been banished once and for all. 🔮

We polished the arcane circles, untied the knots of lustful magic, and now your adventures will be smoother, hotter, and far more wicked. 🧙‍♀️🔥

Step back into a world of intrigue, temptation, and forbidden pleasures — uninterrupted, unchained, and unapologetically erotic. 💫
